episodes.title: Downsize
episodes.summary: Brent learns that his branch of the paper merchants might be closed down, but promises he won't allow any redundancies.

episodes.title: Work Experience
episodes.summary: Donna, the work experience girl, has her first day dominated by a dirty picture of her boss that's been e-mailed around the office.

episodes.title: The Quiz
episodes.summary: It's Tim's birthday, but it's also the annual quiz night. Brent and Finchy vow to maintain their unbeaten record.

episodes.title: Training
episodes.summary: It's staff training day. However, Brent soon starts to undermine the management consultant. It's all too much for Tim, who resigns.

episodes.title: New Girl
episodes.summary: Though he's supposed to be making redundancies, Brent hires a new secretary. And later, it's beers all round as the team go to Slough's top nightclub.

episodes.title: Judgement
episodes.summary: It's bad news as Brent hears his Slough branch is to be merged. Though there will be job losses, his position is safe.

episodes.title: Merger
episodes.summary: Award-winning sitcom, filmed documentary-style and set in the offices of a Slough paper merchant. A group of well-trained and highly motivated personnel come over from Swindon.

episodes.title: Appraisals
episodes.summary: After a disastrous fire drill, David completes the staff appraisals and then tries to improve his popularity with the ‘Swindon lot'. Gareth has his eye on the new girl.

episodes.title: Party
episodes.summary: David Brent is made an offer he cannot refuse, while Gareth turns on the charm and Trudy's birthday celebrations turn a little raunchy.

episodes.title: Motivation
episodes.summary: Brent finds a new string to his bow and makes some easy money moonlighting, while Gareth finds a kindred spirit in a visiting IT specialist.

episodes.title: Charity
episodes.summary: It's Red Nose Day, and the staff are in a charitable mood, but David Brent receives some devastating news.

episodes.title: Interview
episodes.summary: David Brent says his goodbyes after being retrenched from Wernham-Hogg. Tim finally plucks up the courage to talk to Dawn before she leaves for America.
